target_customer: Environmental services, energy, oil and gas and vegetation management firms and consultants that run projects across many field sites
problem: Teams manage thousands of site locations across spreadsheets, drawings, tasks, costs and communications, with no single live map view.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for map based project management and field operations
product_category: Geospatial project management and field operations software

founders.name: Vincent Lam
education: BASc Computer Engineering, University of British Columbia
previous_startups: Several startups since 2011 (names not given on YC page)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page: about 20 years delivering software and several award winning startups since 2011.

founders.name: Sean Huang
previous_startups: Three startups, including VR and AR ventures (names not given on YC page)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page: sales and business development background, Telus door to door sales, time in Shanghai.

competitors.name: Esri ArcGIS
competitors.what: Dominant GIS platform; Matidor became an Esri partner and listed itself in Esri's partner directory

technical_complexity.rationale: A map centric project management app with offline field sync and integrations is standard SaaS with some geospatial work.

defensibility.rationale: Customers store site data, budgets and compliance workflows in the product, but generic project management tools and GIS vendors can add similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Matidor partnered with Esri rather than competing; no copying or acquisition found through 2026.

market_need_then: Matidor's 2020 TechCrunch Startup Battlefield placing and early customers such as Arup (partnership announced in trade press) show demand for map based collaboration; the YC description cites energy operators managing environmental activities across thousands of locations.

branding.domain_note: The company uses matidor.com (YC lists it as Matidor.com); acquisition story not found. Legal entity per site footer is 2xM Creations Inc.
branding.community_and_virality: Reached second place at TechCrunch Disrupt 2020 Startup Battlefield and was a SXSW pitch finalist (Techcouver, February 2021).

brand_strength.rationale: Some tech press and competition wins, but a niche B2B brand with no mascot, merch or community evidence.

outcome_analysis: Matidor, a Vancouver map based project management company, placed second at TechCrunch Disrupt Startup Battlefield in 2020, joined YC Summer 2021 and raised a seed of about 1.9 million dollars in January 2022. It has named customers such as GFL Environmental, Peyto and Arup and an Esri partnership, and remains small. No later priced round, acquisition or shutdown was found, so it looks like a modest, steady niche SaaS business.
notes: Seed amount reported at 1.7M to 1.9M and total at 1.98M to 2.03M across Signalbase, Seedtable, Extruct and CB Insights; the seed figure and investor list are from aggregator-style sources (page contents not opened), so treat as partly unverified. Seedtable names MassChallenge as lead. Founding year is 2019 per YC, 2018 or 2020 elsewhere. Competitor lists from CB Insights (Felt, BigGeo, Unearth) and an aggregator (monday.com, Asana) are undated and excluded from the as-of-founding list. Esri is recorded as a platform and partner rather than a head on rival. Name origin not found.
